source.title: Ríos y Quebradas del Perú (Red Hidrográfica)

assessment.reason: La red lineal puede ayudar a normalizar nombres, revisar conectividad y proponer outlets, pero la descarga no proviene de un endpoint oficial verificable y no demuestra por sí sola linaje, licencia, fecha, proyección ni topología.
allowed_uses: propose outlet-snapping candidates for DEM review
identify candidate basin and subbasin references
forbidden_uses: credit the mirror as verified ANA evidence
derive or promote rainfall or hydraulic thresholds
treat missing features as absence of hazard

requirements: obtain or identify the original ANA publication endpoint
record dataset vintage, CRS and schema
validate geometry and topology against an official ANA or CENEPRED reference
use DEM flow direction and accumulation to confirm each watershed and outlet
